selection: 2024 only: execution costs <=75% of reference, net return >= reference, maximum drawdown <= reference +1 percentage point. Among eligible variants maximize net return minus drawdown, tie favors first listed. If none pass, retain reference and do not create candidate.
review_gate: Each review window must reduce execution costs >=25%, preserve reference net return, keep drawdown within reference +1 percentage point, and remain profitable at double execution costs. Never automatically promote or retune after review.
limitations: All windows are retrospective and previously available; none is claimed as untouched or prospective OOS.
No macro/news filters in this mechanism comparison.
Longer waiting can miss trends. Preserve protective exits and actual configured fees; do not assume maker fills.
